_: Quark, from ATM6's census (W4 R6, judged 2026-11-11). Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because any word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Their bricks, pavements, pillars, slabs, stairs and walls were not judged and are left to the rules.

Stone: jasper and permafrost are natural rock Quark lays in the ground, with no stone word. Elder prismarine is the rock of Quark's prismarine caves: its one recipe needs elder prismarine already, so what lies in the caves was never made. End: myalite and dusky myalite were seen only in the End's highlands, as its own ground.
Cobble: cobbedstone is broken rock, a form of cobblestone, and detection gave it stone by the stone in its name.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.16.5 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.

Nether: Quark's basalt is the Nether's own ground in every edition, as 1.12.2's census judged it where RLCraft saw it only in the Nether (Xep, 2026-11-13: Nether everywhere; W4 R15); detection gave it stone by the stone word in basalt. Its bricks and pavement are made and left to the rules.
